resources.string: The note you play appears here as a name, whole cents and Hz, with a needle showing how far it sits from centre. Detection is scheduled for a later build.
A held reference tone appears here: a tone grid with octave steps, three voices and a volume. Sound is scheduled for a later build.
The click appears here: tempo, time signature, accents and a beat row. Sound is scheduled for a later build.
Every note you hold builds a curve here. The table lists each note with its spread for this session or all history. Storage is scheduled for a later build.
Settings appear here: instrument, A4, written or concert pitch, spelling, response, noise floor, keep-awake, drone voice, click sound and visual offset.
